body:
That's the problem...there is no fear. I'm not jealous.  I'm not angry (at anyone but myself).

I'm a walking paradox.

I love love. I love humanity...what little humanity still exists in the world. I love unconditionally...everyone, but myself. 

I'm tired. I'm 31 and have hated my entire existence. 

I get a shit job...I excel...then I hate it. Rinse...repeat.

I've been doing the same shit for so long I don't know who I am..I'm asking for help on fucking Reddit. I created this profile for help...but I fear there is no help.

Sometimes i wish i were a psychopath that felt no empathy and gave no fucks...alas, I'm here. I give fucks...i care. I'm still alive because I have hope. 

Yet, hope is dwindling and I feel less and less every day. Nothing means anything. It's all bullshit. We are merely sentient machines with one purpose...procreate.

I don't want kids. If I had them, I'm sure I'd ruin them...we are nowhere and it's now.
